sources.note: Main product page. Describes DrCloudEHR as cloud-based behavioral health EHR with clinical, billing, telehealth, patient portal, and AI features. Lists target markets: mental health, SUD, CCBHC, IDD, children/family services.

ONC transparency page. Lists certified capabilities including CPOE, drug interactions, transitions of care, APIs, immunization/syndromic reporting. Notes third-party costs for DrFirst ePrescribing and EMRDirect DIRECT messaging.

Company page. 22+ years experience, 70+ staff, 170+ enterprises served, $175M+ in projects. Offices in Beaverton OR, Hinsdale IL, Washington DC, Hyderabad India. Government contracting vehicles (CIO-SP3, GSA MAS).
Feature overview page. Describes clinical management, practice management, RCM, patient engagement, reporting/dashboards modules. MU Stage 3 certified.

CCBHC-specific page. Covers nine required CCBHC service areas, referral/intake management, eMAR, ePrescribing, form builder, Connections Suite interoperability, integrated billing, standard/custom reports.

AI features page. AI Group Scribing with speaker diarization (up to 15 participants), sentiment analysis, per-speaker summaries, clinical keyword detection. Also mentions DrCloudDictate and DrCloudIQ.

Yamhill County HHS selection. Competitive procurement for integrated behavioral health, developmental disabilities, and public health. Consolidating fragmented legacy systems. Mentions ePrescribing, telehealth, portal, CCBHC module.
Vitality Unlimited (Nevada CCBHC with 4 locations) selected DrCloudEHR. First Nevada CCBHC adopter in 2017.
Marion County HHS contract. Unanimous board vote. Selected for behavioral health, developmental disabilities, and public health services.
IDD/ABA-specific page. Describes ABA assessment tools, data analysis capabilities, configurable workflows for developmental disability services.

EHRGuide review. 8.6/10 rating. Notes form builder, eMAR, integrated billing with Office Ally clearinghouse, telehealth, Golden Thread quality management. Pros: BH specialization, low cost, responsive support. Cons: steep learning curve, UI issues.
Capterra listing (403 blocked, info from search results). 4.2/5 stars from 13 reviews. Users praise customizability and customer service. Complaints about page load times and data entry issues.
Partnership with PH-SS to support CCBHCs nationwide in certification and process improvement.
